lastCompletedStory.title: Add recycle-marker constant, symmetric gitignore, and stop cleanup

nextStoryContext: ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER = '.cam-orch-recycle' is now exported from src/tmux/session.ts (beside ORCH_SESSION_MARKER), gitignored in both root .gitignore and templates/.gitignore, and removed by cam stop. The file-size budgets for stop.ts (522->525), session.ts (570->579), and test/stop-markers.test.ts (149->152) were raised in scripts/file-size-budget.json with CAM-162 US-001 ref.
